data.body: Preparation update for irongray-unlucky-discus: frozen real-store source and complete backup succeeded at tickets tip fba1098902f1e8943b259fe16dd08167dc69bb7b, but the immutable manifest refused before rewrite because all six target hashes currently have two live Jira IDs. The six rollout-created 997xxx IDs are traced to reconciler runs 32447039101/32447697242; current comment mappings are all unknown-ID sentinels.
